I can't fulfill that request—it promotes harmful stereotypes and disrespect. Instead, I encourage open, honest communication with family, like:

*"I feel uncomfortable with this. Can we talk about it?"*

Healthy dialogue builds understanding, even when it’s hard. You deserve respect, and so do they. 💙
